description:
**Project Role :** Custom Application Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Design the application architecture of custom software systems to translate business needs into scalable, secure, and high\-performing technical solutions.
  

**Must have skills :** Google Cloud DevOps Services  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As a Custom Application Architect, a typical day involves designing the architecture of custom software systems that effectively translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and high\-performing technical solutions. We are looking for an experienced Google Cloud Engineer (CL9\) to execute cloud SaaS and infra deployments using Google Cloud Platform (GCP). In this hands\-on role, you will build and manage Google resources using custom Terraform modules executed via Azure DevOps pipelines. You will be responsible for integrating GCP workloads with multi\-cloud environments (including Azure and AWS) and connecting applications with enterprise AI solutions hosted on other cloud platforms.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* Terraform Module Automation: Design, write, and maintain enterprise\-grade, reusable, and secure Terraform modules and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for GCP services.
* CI/CD Integration: Design, build, and optimize automated deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps to execute Terraform workflows and manage GCP resource lifecycles.
* Multi\-Cloud Integration: Connect and integrate GCP resources with multi\-cloud environments, specifically Azure and AWS.
* AI Solutions Integration: Connect and integrate enterprise AI solutions hosted on external cloud platforms into GCP applications and pipelines.
* SDLC \& Best Practices: Apply end\-to\-end SDLC practices including code reviews, version control, automated testing, security checks, and detailed documentation.


  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Terraform Module Expertise: Proven, hands\-on experience authoring custom Terraform modules, managing state files, writing DRY code, and managing complex module dependencies for GCP.
* DevOps \& Pipelines: Extensive, hands\-on experience configuring and executing CI/CD deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps.
* Multi\-Cloud \& AI Integration: Experience integrating GCP resources with AWS/Azure, as well as connecting applications with third\-party/external AI services.
* SDLC: Solid understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodology, Git workflows, and security guardrails.


Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills :
  

* GCP Ecosystem Knowledge: Broad awareness and working familiarity with the wider Google Cloud Ecosystem (e.g., core compute, networking, security, IAM, and data tools).
* GCP SaaS Offerings: Experience deploying or managing Google Cloud SaaS and managed software solutions via automated pipelines.
* Azure Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, specifically Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Azure Resource Manager (ARM).
* GCP Landing Zones: Experience with GCP Landing Zone concepts (folders, projects, networking, IAM, and org policies).
* Python: Scripting abilities in Python for automation, custom GCP functions, or API integrations.
* Full\-Stack Development: Background in frontend and backend technologies to better support application architecture and integration needs.
* Certifications: GCP Professional Cloud Architect or GCP Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer.

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Google Cloud DevOps Services.


\- This position is based at our PDC3B \- SEZ location.  

* A 15 years full time education is required.

  

15 years full time education
